description: Evaluation rubrics for video/voice mock interview feedback, WPM cadence, filler word analysis, and STAR methodology.

situation.criteria: Sets background context clearly without excessive ramblings. Specifies team size, project context, or company scenario.

task.criteria: Explicitly defines the specific problem, goal, deadline, or engineering challenge to be solved.

action.criteria: Details specific personal contributions, technologies selected, architectural decisions, and steps taken (uses 'I' instead of vague 'We').

result.criteria: Provides concrete, quantifiable metrics and business/technical impact (e.g. 'reduced latency by 35%', 'handled 10k DAU').

feedback.tooSlow: Speaking pace is below 110 WPM. Try to convey your ideas with more energy and steady momentum.
feedback.optimal: Excellent speaking pace (130-160 WPM). Clear cadence and easy for interviewers to follow.
feedback.tooFast: Speaking pace exceeds 180 WPM. Pause deliberately at key points so interviewers digest complex details.
